SYN-0003.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SYN-0003 emitted only when the artifact at output_path exists, is non-empty, parses against output_schema, and every CAUSE node maps to exactly one rival record or one explicit SINGLE-HYPOTHESIS label. Any other terminal state is FAILED:SYN-0003 <classification> with the diagnostic tail attached.
SYN-0003.evidence_requirement: One record per CAUSE node: rival statement, the observation both hypotheses predict, the observation they predict DIFFERENTLY, and the exact command or probe that would collect it. A rival that predicts nothing different is not a rival and must be recorded as NON-DISCRIMINATING rather than counted.
inputs: Phase 12 refutation artifacts (bucket B10) -- refuters often already named the rival
SYN-0003.question_or_target: Question: for each CAUSE node in the hierarchy, what is the strongest RIVAL causal explanation of the same symptom set, and what single experiment would separate the two? A cause admitted with no rival considered must be labelled SINGLE-HYPOTHESIS in the final report. This is the synthesis-time counterpart of the spec's demand for 'counterevidence to every major conclusion' (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10700) applied to causation rather than to claims.
SYN-0003.retry_policy: one retry ONLY in a fresh context with the inputs re-read from disk, because the dominant failure mode here is an anchored prior, not a flaky tool
SYN-0003.reviewer_requirement: one reviewer served ONLY the raw inputs and the recorded probe output, who must re-derive the verdict BEFORE being shown this unit's conclusion; a reviewer who reads the conclusion first has been anchored and does not count
tests_required: test_no_rival_is_a_restatement (token-overlap gate against the original cause text)
SYN-0003.title: Rival-explanation generation: every root cause gets a competing hypothesis and a discriminating experiment

SYN-0007.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SYN-0007 emitted only when the artifact at output_path exists, is non-empty, parses against output_schema, and every ranked row enumerates its prevented claim ids. Any other terminal state is FAILED:SYN-0007 <classification> with the diagnostic tail attached.
SYN-0007.evidence_requirement: Each row states the prevented subtree by explicit claim-id list (not a count alone), the phase at which the intervention was available with its spec line, and the cost basis. A row whose cost is asserted rather than derived must carry an ESTIMATE tag with its band.
inputs: command-center/PHASE-GRAPH.json (which phase could have caught it)
SYN-0007.question_or_target: Question: for each root cause, what is the CHEAPEST EARLIER action that would have prevented the largest number of downstream findings, and at which phase could it have been taken? Target: a ranked intervention table (subtree size x severity / estimated cost) that tells the Phase 16 loop what to build first. This is prioritisation of prevention, distinct from SYN-0047 which maps causes onto the existing regression surface and distinct from IMP-0384 which performs the writeback.
SYN-0007.retry_policy: one retry only when the failure classifies as environment-transient (429, DNS, disk, runner eviction); a logic or evidence failure is never retried
SYN-0007.reviewer_requirement: two independent reviewers who do not see each other's verdict until both are filed; a split escalates to raw-source adjudication, never to a majority vote
SYN-0007.title: Counterfactual earliest-intervention ranking: which single earlier action would have prevented the largest subtree

SYN-0008.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SYN-0008 emitted only when the artifact at output_path exists, is non-empty, parses against output_schema, and >=3 candidates exist, span >=2 vendors, and the leak fixture is recorded as DENIED. Any other terminal state is FAILED:SYN-0008 <classification> with the diagnostic tail attached.
SYN-0008.evidence_requirement: For each candidate: vendor, model, the exact partition manifest it was given, wall-clock start and end, and the sha256 of its prompt file. Cross-vendor dispatch must be FOREGROUND and prove completion with exit code 0 AND a non-empty parsed output file -- a job id, a 'started in the background' string, or a progress stream is a SEVERED result, not a synthesis.
inputs: Phase 10/11/12/13 artifact sets (buckets B08, B09, B10, B11)
SYN-0008.question_or_target: Implementation target: execute the spec's 'multiple independent synthesis agents' (_USER-PROMPTS.md:11088) as >=3 synthesizers that (a) span at least two vendors, (b) receive DISJOINT-plus-shared-core evidence partitions, and (c) cannot read each other's output until all N are filed. The independence is a property of the harness, not a promise in the prompt: the dispatcher must be unable to leak sibling output, and that must be proven by a leak-attempt fixture.
SYN-0008.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot (AGENTS.md 4b): after the 2nd failure carrying the same error fingerprint, enumerate >=2 mechanically different approaches before any 3rd attempt; a 3rd identical retry is a unit failure
SYN-0008.reviewer_requirement: any reviewer who authored ANY synthesis candidate under review is disqualified; the reviewer roster must be joined against the author roster and the empty intersection recorded in the receipt
tests_required: leak fixture: a synthesizer that requests a sibling's output must be denied and the denial logged
SYN-0008.title: Run N-way independent synthesis under information partition and cross-vendor diversity

The measured estate precedent is stark -- agents self-rated high confidence on 89 percent of findings while 42 percent of those checked were REFUTED.
